data.title: Elapsed Time Explorers

challenges.instruction: The train leaves the station at 2:00 and arrives at its destination at 2:30. How much time passed during the trip?
challenges.hint: Count by tens or count the minutes on the clock face from the start time to the end time.

challenges.instruction: Art class starts at 3:15 and ends at 4:00. How long was art class?
challenges.hint: Think about how many minutes are left to get to the next hour, and then add the minutes of the new hour.

challenges.instruction: Soccer practice begins at 5:00 and finishes at 6:30. How long did you practice soccer?
challenges.hint: Look at the hours first. How many whole hours passed? Then check the minutes.

challenges.instruction: A movie starts at 7:15 and finishes at 8:45. How long was the movie?
challenges.hint: Find the difference between the starting hours and starting minutes, or count forward by hours and minutes.

challenges.instruction: Baking cookies takes you from 10:30 until 11:15. How much time did you spend baking?
challenges.hint: Count from 10:30 to 11:00, and then add the extra minutes past 11:00.

data.description: Learn how to calculate elapsed time by finding the duration between a start time and an end time on the analog clock using quarter-hour intervals.
